note:
Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B decoder layer 0, kernels 6 and 7: causal GQA attention. hidden=1024 heads=16 kv_heads=8 head_dim=128, fp32, seq 128. One of the twelve layer-0 kernels the perf suite curated before the corpus became its case source.

The schedule is SITE-SCOPED (TILE@map.1/twist.1/inner is the score, TILE@map.1/twist the weighted sum) because a flash tree decides per site. The carrier's scalar register tile is the schedule this case is about: the tier folds the term's own step, so the recipe's three states each get a cell copy and the fp32 target needs no mma atom for them.

attrs.body:
let f32 v0 = -1000000000.0
let f32 v1 = 0.0
let f32 v2 = 0.0883883461356163
for a0 in 0..16:
    for a1 in 0..128:
        for a2 in 0..128:
            for a3 in 0..128:
                in0 = load k[0, a0 / 2, a2, a3]
                in1 = load q[0, a0, a1, a3]
                v3 = multiply(in0, in1)
                acc1 <- add(acc1, v3) over a3
            v4 = multiply(acc1, v2)
            v5 = select:
                v1 when a2 <= a1
                v0 when a1 < a2
            v6 = add(v5, v4)
            acc0 <- maximum(acc0, v6) over a2
        for a2 in 0..128:
            for a5 in 0..128:
                in2 = load k[0, a0 / 2, a2, a5]
                in3 = load q[0, a0, a1, a5]
                v7 = multiply(in2, in3)
                acc3 <- add(acc3, v7) over a5
            v8 = multiply(acc3, v2)
            v9 = select:
                v1 when a2 <= a1
                v0 when a1 < a2
            v10 = add(v9, v8)
            v11 = subtract(v10, acc0)
            v12 = exp(v11)
            acc2 <- add(acc2, v12) over a2
        for a6 in 0..128:
            for a7 in 0..128:
                for a8 in 0..128:
                    in4 = load k[0, a0 / 2, a7, a8]
                    in5 = load q[0, a0, a1, a8]
                    v13 = multiply(in4, in5)
                    acc5 <- add(acc5, v13) over a8
                v14 = multiply(acc5, v2)
                in6 = load v[0, a0 / 2, a7, a6]
                v15 = select:
                    v1 when a7 <= a1
                    v0 when a1 < a7
                v16 = add(v15, v14)
                v17 = subtract(v16, acc0)
                v18 = exp(v17)
                v19 = divide(v18, acc2)
                v20 = multiply(in6, v19)
                acc4 <- add(acc4, v20) over a7
            o[0, a0, a1, a6] = acc4
